measures.title: Council Compensation Adjustment and Inflation Limitation Measure
measures.summary: Amends the Roseville City Charter to raise city councilmember pay from $600 a month, set by voters in 2000, to $2,550 a month. Pay would then adjust each year with the California Consumer Price Index, capped at 5% a year, and any other change to council pay would still need voter approval.
measures.yesMeans: Council pay rises to $2,550 a month with yearly inflation adjustments capped at 5%.
measures.noMeans: Council pay stays at $600 a month.
